text: Week 12.
No visit this time.
Laila scans again on her phone.
And she renews.
One Laila proves nothing.
300 could.
That's our target for 2027.
So we write the rules now, before we fall in love with the idea.
We go ahead if at least 40% book a second visit within 90 days and every visit makes money.
Then, the next €7 million are released at the Q4 2027 review, and we add salons.
We change course if people come back, but the money doesn't work.
New price, new services, or a new deal with ServiceMarket.
We fall back if salons won't send their colorists out.
Then, we test a salon subscription instead cheaper, safer.
And we stop after two missed reviews in a row.
Stopping early is cheaper than being right too late.
So this is our ask.
Not a big bet.
90 days in Dubai inside the €3 million already planned, it buys proof, not volume.
ServiceMarket at the door, the salon in the room, and your support.
Give us 12 weeks.
Laila already did.
